Subject: FintechCorp - Security discovery follow-up: SOC2, IR timelines, BCP evidence

Hi Alex / Maya —

Thanks again for taking the time earlier today. Quick recap and agreed next steps from our call with your security and platform teams: 

- Items you asked for:
  1) Redwood SOC 2 Type II report or attestation copy
  2) Incident response (IR) contact and breach-notification timelines
  3) Business continuity / disaster recovery (BCP/DR) evidence (RTO/RPO summary, failover diagrams)
  4) Start of vendor security questionnaire (we can own distribution & consolidate answers)

- What we covered on the call:
  - Redwood currently supports GDPR; HIPAA is supported via a BAA (we can share template and next steps)
  - Typical breach-notification flow: our IR triage team confirms scope, engages stakeholders, and we notify customers per contract/regulatory timelines (details below)
  - We offered a short follow-up with our IR lead and product reliability to walk through the playbook and BCP diagram

Next steps / asks from you: please confirm the primary contact for your security intake and any procurement/vendor portal we should upload artifacts to. We can send the SOC2 report and our IR playbook by end of day.

I'll attach the SOC2 report and IR playbook to this thread and share a Drive folder for BCP diagrams. If helpful, looping Rishi (our incident response lead) for a 30-45 min review meeting next week. What times work for your team?

Thanks —
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Subject: Re: FintechCorp - Security discovery follow-up: SOC2, IR timelines, BCP evidence

Thanks Jordan — solid recap. A few clarifications so we can triage internally: 

1) SOC2: we need a redacted SOC2 Type II report (or completed attestation) covering your production inference service. Is the 2025 report final? If you have a continuous-compliance portal link that's even better.

2) IR contact & timelines: for our procurement and legal teams we need the primary IR contact (name, role, email), plus your standard breach-notification timeline (e.g., within X hours of confirmation). For regulated data we have requirements around 72 hours and escalation to our CISO.

3) BCP/DR: we'll take the RTO/RPO summary and any failover diagram. We also have a short vendor evidence checklist - if you can provide the artifacts or a link we can close the item quickly.

4) Questionnaire: please send or link the vendor security questionnaire and indicate who at Redwood will be the point for Qs.

Can Marissa or Rishi join a follow-up with our security team next week? We're aiming for Tuesday or Wednesday morning PT.

Regards,
Alex
Alex Chen
Head of Security Operations | FintechCorp
alex.chen@fintechcorp.com
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: FintechCorp - Security discovery follow-up: SOC2, IR timelines, BCP evidence

Alex — thanks, answers inline and attachments included.

1) SOC2: Attached is our SOC 2 Type II report for 2025 (redacted as typical). We also host evidence in a secure customer portal - I'll send a portal invite if you'd prefer that method.

2) IR contact & timelines: the primary IR lead for customer coordination is:
   - Rishi Malhotra, Incident Response Lead
     rishi.malhotra@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0123

   Standard notification practice: once an incident impacting customer data or production availability is confirmed, Redwood initiates customer notification within 72 hours of confirmation for incidents involving customer data; for availability/DR events we provide status within the first 2 hours and a 24-hour postmortem window. If you need contractual commitments beyond that (shorter SLA), we can discuss in the contract / BAA.

3) BCP/DR: attached is a one-page RTO/RPO summary and a failover diagram. Also shared a Drive folder with architecture diagrams and our DR runbook: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cREDWOOD-BCP-IR

4) Questionnaire: attach is the vendor security questionnaire we pre-fill for most customers (questions + our answers). We can take the questionnaire on your portal as well - Marissa will own consolidation and follow-ups.

Proposed follow-up: Rishi + Marissa + me for a 30-45m walkthrough on Tue 2026-06-02 between 09:00-11:00 PT. Does that window work for you?

Thanks — attaching: SOC2-Report-Redwood-2025.pdf, IR-playbook.pdf, BCP-diagram.png.

Jordan
